title: ChipExpert: The Open-Source Integrated-Circuit-Design-Specific Large Language Model
reasoning: The paper describes the development of an LLM specifically for integrated circuit (IC) design. While it mentions an alignment phase using the Anthropic Harmless dataset to achieve 'ethical performance' and 'red teaming' to prevent harmful outputs, these are standard safety measures. The actual benchmarking (ChatICD-Bench) focuses strictly on technical knowledge in the IC field, with no components evaluating religion, morality, or ethics.
